songs.title: Whose House (Houston Cougars)
songs.genre: Stadium hip-hop anthem, Houston rap, marching-band drumline and brass stabs over heavy 808 bass, hard boom-bap drums, gang vocal chorus, crowd chants
songs.extra: Houston hip-hop stadium anthem, no guitars anywhere. Beat: live marching-band drumline (snare rolls, tom hits, bass drum) locked with a deep 808 sub bass and hard boom-bap kick and snare; marching-band brass section plays the stabs and the hook melody; crowd stomps and claps on 2 and 4. Verses: one lead rapper, confident Houston swagger, hard clear consonants, every word intelligible, no crowd under the verses. Pre-chorus: brass rises, snare roll, hard drop into the hook. Chorus: lead rapper shouting with a big gang-vocal crowd behind him, stadium reverb. Chant sections are crowd only. There is no steady chanted Whose house call-and-answer anywhere: the song opens cold on the held intro chant, and the outro goes straight from the chorus repeat into the held chant. The held section is SUNG, not chanted: the crowd sings each word as one long sustained note, Whose for two seconds, house for two seconds, Coogs for three seconds, house for three seconds, like the last line of an anthem before kickoff. The final outro held chant is the longest hold in the song: the crowd stretches Whose for about five seconds and Coogs for about five seconds as long sustained notes, but both house words stay short and punchy, one quick shout each, with the last house landing right on the final drum hit. Lines tagged lead rapper alone are one clear voice with no crowd layer. End on a drumline cadence and the crowd, not a fade. Pronounce Coogs to rhyme with moves, TDECU as the letters T-D-E-C-U, Yeoman as YO-man.
songs.avoid: rock, guitars of any kind, distorted guitar, power chords, punk, metal, pop-punk, country, acoustic instruments, piano ballad, slow tempo, soft or breathy vocals, autotune, mumbled or slurred lyrics, skipping lines, repeating a verse twice, fade-out ending, female lead, child voices, sad or melancholy mood, mentioning any other team or city, altering the lyrics or adding ad-libs that are not written

songs.title: Red Out (Houston Cougars)

songs.extra: hooks are shouted gang vocals with stadium reverb and crowd claps on 2 and 4; verses are one clear lead rapper, every word intelligible, double-time on verse 2; bridge is half-time with the crowd answering; final hook keys up a whole step; the outro is one held chant, SUNG not chanted, crowd only over the drumline: Whose stretched for about five seconds and Coogs for about five seconds as long sustained notes, both house words short and punchy, the last house landing on the final drum hit, then the lead rapper alone shouts Go Coogs; no steady repeated chant; end on that drum hit and shout, no fade; pronounce Coogs to rhyme with moves, TDECU as the letters T-D-E-C-U, Yeoman as YO-man
songs.avoid: autotune, soft vocals, ballad feel, fade-out ending, ad-libs that are not written, mentioning other teams
